items.title: Micron Faces Growing China Threat. It’s a Bigger Problem for Memory-Chip Rivals.
items.summary: CXMT—which is a specialist in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM)— intends to establish a NAND flash memory research-and-development production line at a new factory in Beijing, Reuters reported Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.  DRAM is short-term working memory that computers and artificial-intelligence hardware use to manage active data and running processes.  NAND flash memory is used for longer-term storage.
